tagline: 宾得数码单反相机，2005 年发布
description: 宾得于2005年推出的数码单反相机。配备Interchangeable Pentax "crippled" KAF2 mount compatible with Pentax auto-aperture lenses; older lenses supported in stop-down metering mode.。快门速度1/4000 sec – 30 sec, Bulb。

specs.镜头: Interchangeable Pentax "crippled" KAF2 mount compatible with Pentax auto-aperture lenses; older lenses supported in stop-down metering mode.
specs.曝光测光: TTL open-aperture metering with choice of: 16-segment, Center-weighted Average & Spot meter
specs.电池: 4x AA or 2x CR-V3, Optional AC adapter
specs.重量: 470 g (1 lb) without battery, 565 g with battery
